set.body:
Add temporal SurfaceMatrix/field sources with typed time axes, lazy frame access, interpolation policy, playback reducer, prefetch, and bounded caches. Add morphing across SurfaceSet variants only after topology identity proves exact vertex/face correspondence; recompute or interpolate normals under an explicit policy. Add linked image/surface selection through world coordinates and existing surfaceToWorld/spatial morphism contracts, plus typed vertex annotations and reproducible selection history.

Acceptance: temporal frame counts and times are validated; no unbounded frame retention; camera-only and prefetched playback receipts distinguish uploads; morph endpoints are exact and incompatible variants fail before rendering; linked picks roundtrip through known volume/surface fixtures without implicit coordinate flips; JVM and JS semantics match and live hosts remain responsive at recorded target sizes.
set.title: Surface dynamic viewing: temporal fields, morphing, linked image views, and annotations
